title: Mystic Rune Ritual
description: A hooded figure in a brown robe kneels before a large ancient stone door covered in glowing runes, as molten orange light flows from the door's opening onto the cracked floor inscribed with magical symbols. The stone chamber contains scattered scrolls, an overturned pot spilling dark contents, and a small dish with rings, with a crescent moon visible through a high window against a twilight sky.
prompt: A hooded wizard in a flowing brown robe kneels on the floor of a stone chamber, facing a massive ancient stone door covered in glowing runes. Bright orange molten light pours from the door's archway, illuminating magical symbols etched into the cracked floor. Scattered around are old scrolls, an overturned pot spilling dark powder, and a small dish with rings. A crescent moon is visible through a high window in the stone wall under a twilight sky, in a detailed fantasy style.
